brief:
French President Emmanuel Macron called the Gaza situation "a spectacle that shames us all" while addressing the 81st session of the UN General Assembly in New York, Middle East Eye reported. Macron criticized world leaders for their inactivity in response to what he characterized as Israeli violations.

The remarks came as France joined global discourse on the humanitarian crisis in Gaza, with Macron framing the international community's response as inadequate.
